items.description: An Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code/Codex as an AI collaborator in your vault
Get tasks and ideas out of your head. A free GTD to-do app for desktop and mobile. Works offline, no account needed
Terminal session manager for AI coding agents. One TUI for Claude, Gemini, OpenCode, Codex, and more.
Kition brings Markdown, DataTable, WhiteBoard, a tool-using AI agent, browser research, and visual workflows into one desktop workspace.
The next-generation Markdown editor, with an AI writing assistant. Free and open source for macOS, Windows and Linux.

Termul is Terminal Ultimate Manager a cross-platform desktop terminal manager built with Tauri and React. Organize terminals by workspace with persistent sessions, multiple shell, split panes, embedded browser tabs, and a built-in code & markdown editor.
A lightweight, open-source Alfred-style launcher for Windows.

macOS 鼠标/触控板手势自定义工具。按住该手势的触发键（默认右键，也可中键 / 侧键）绘制轨迹，匹配后执行快捷键、打开应用、窗口操作、媒体键、Shell / AppleScript 等 ｜ A macOS mouse gesture customization tool. Hold down the trigger key to execute shortcuts, open applications, shell/AppleScript, etc. after matching.

Free, sub-second on-device AI dictation for macOS. Dual engines (Whisper + Parakeet) on Apple Silicon. Optional AI polish on your Mac with EG-1 or S1-mini by Superwhisper, Apple Intelligence (macOS 26), Ollama, or your own OpenAI/Gemini/Claude key. Snippets, custom words, no account, no subscription, audio never leaves your Mac.
Open-source workspace for professional document AI: reviewable agent edits, source-linked work, three-way document merges, and an extensible plugin runtime. Starting with legal work.
One macOS app for Claude Code, Codex, and every agent runtime you use — scheduled runs, global hotkey launcher, per-run git worktrees, one review board.

Your work, already underway. A personal AI assistant for your job: mail, chats and tickets become tasks, the agents you already use (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) do the work, and nothing goes out until you approve. Open source, runs on your machine.
One AI agent, everywhere you work — terminal, desktop, mobile, and your chat apps. Rust core.
Use two computers as one desk: Mac,     Windows and Linux on the same network. Share screens, mouse and keyboard, clipboard, files, sound, notifications, terminals and apps.
